verdict.rationale: Stripe documents a USDC stablecoin balance in a Financial Account that can receive, store and send funds (public preview). It also documents automatic fiat-stablecoin conversion at the edges: crypto payments settle as fiat, and Connect stablecoin payouts convert from a fiat platform balance. Nothing in the pack shows a finance lead moving value between their own fiat and stablecoin balances or rebalancing them. Missing for 10: documented internal fiat↔stablecoin transfer/conversion between own balances, rebalancing via API or dashboard, end-to-end treasury workflow docs, GA status (Treasury stablecoins is preview), independent corroboration.
